hints.title: Three Consecutive Matching Characters
hints.text: A good integer requires three identical consecutive digits.

hints.title: Candidates from 999 down to 000
hints.text: Checking candidates from '999' downward allows stopping early at the very first match found.

hints.title: Subsequence Presence Test
hints.text: Testing whether string contains d * 3 for d from '9' down to '0' directly produces the largest result.

hints.title: Descending Candidate Scan Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing at most 10 constant substrings of length 3.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all substrings is fine but descending search is cleanest.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks descending candidate triples from 9 down to 0 for immediate resolution.
